label: For all types: a time reindexing preserving a condition on complete paths fixes…, by Direct-proof
meaning: Apply uniqueness to the reindexed solution to get symmetry transfer; on Int conclude no change by induction. Compose #736 no_selection with the re-dated rival for the whole-vector failure, and #738 uniqueness for the global instance.
